scripts.build: npm run build -w @loop/types && npm run build -w @loop/api && npm run build -w @loop/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces && eslint scripts tests *.ts *.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/check-vocabulary.ts
scripts.test: npm run build -w @loop/types && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @loop/types && concurrently -k -n types,api,web "npm run dev -w @loop/types" "npm run dev -w @loop/api" "npm run dev -w @loop/web"
